title: AIIMS Opens BSc Nursing Choice Filling, MSc Round 1 Results on August 6
summary: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) has opened the choice filling for its BSc nursing program and will release the results of the first round of MSc admissions on August 6. Candidates must log in to aiimsexams.ac.in to fill their choices, lock them, and complete further admission steps. The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) UG 2026 counselling has also begun, with classes scheduled to start from September 8.
summary_points: AIIMS opened choice filling for BSc nursing program on August 1
MSc round 1 results will be released on August 6
Candidates must log in to aiimsexams.ac.in to fill and lock choices
NEET UG 2026 counselling has begun, with classes starting from September 8
